description: This header file 'lfunc.h' contains auxiliary function declarations, macros, and constants related to manipulating function prototypes and closures within the Lua interpreter's implementation.

methods.name: luaF_newproto
methods.description: Creates a new function prototype in the Lua state.

methods.name: luaF_newCclosure
methods.description: Creates a new C closure with a specified number of upvalues.

methods.name: luaF_newLclosure
methods.description: Creates a new Lua closure with a specified number of upvalues.

methods.name: luaF_initupvals
methods.description: Initializes the upvalues for a closure.

methods.name: luaF_findupval
methods.description: Finds an upvalue associated with a given stack level.

methods.name: luaF_newtbcupval
methods.description: Creates a new to-be-closed upvalue at a given stack level.

methods.name: luaF_closeupval
methods.description: Closes an upvalue at a given stack level.

methods.name: luaF_unlinkupval
methods.description: Removes an upvalue from the list of open upvalues.

methods.name: luaF_freeproto
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with a prototype.

methods.name: luaF_getlocalname
methods.description: Retrieves the local variable name at a given program counter.
